name: NTR48 ~Ore no Kazoku ga Netorareru made no 48nichikan~
original_name: NTR48 ～俺の家族が寝取られるまでの48日間～
source:
The Kusakabe family, famous for their tight-knit bond in the neighborhood, lived their lives in happiness. But that happiness was gradually... slowly... being shattered behind the scenes. Their family members were being fuckin' stolen by bastards who were supposed to be 'good people.' The crisis of family collapse approaches.

In this work, the protagonist's sister, mother, and childhood friend are being taken away! They fall into the hands of other men one after another in various scenarios. In those scenes, the story progresses not only from the protagonist's or a third party's perspective but also from the heroine's perspective if the switch button is pressed. You'll witness their heart-wrenching emotions and changing feelings of their hearts.
translation:
以邻里间团结紧密著称的日下部一家过着幸福的生活。但这份幸福在幕后正被逐渐……缓慢地……粉碎。他们的家人正被那些本应是“好人”的混蛋们夺走。家庭崩溃的危机正在逼近。

在本作中，主人公的妹妹、母亲和青梅竹马被夺走了！她们在各种场景中一个接一个地落入其他男人的手中。在那些场景中，故事不仅从主人公或第三方的视角推进，按下切换按钮后还可以从女主角的视角来观看。你将目睹她们撕心裂肺的情感和内心的变化。
